sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Mal was an Irish goddess. In the far west of Ireland lies the scenic wonder called the Cliffs of Moher, known in Irish as Ceann na Caillghe, the head of the Hag. The hag in question was Mal. The nearby resort town of Miltown Malbay is named after her. She was said to have given her name to the land after she died pursuing a handsome man across the countryside, intent on making him her lover.

okr.objective: Document Mal, the Irish goddess whose name was given to the Cliffs of Moher and Miltown Malbay.
key_results: Record Mal as the hag behind the Irish name of the Cliffs of Moher.
Record the Irish name Ceann na Caillghe, the head of the Hag.
Record the legend that she died pursuing a handsome man.
Record the naming of Miltown Malbay after her.
